conclusion: The InlongSlicer homepage account/navigation sidebar is intentionally hidden. Its CSS starts with display:none, SetLoginPanelVisibility always keeps LeftBoard hidden, and cloud_providers_info delegates to that function instead of showing the sidebar when Inlong is available. Keep both host update paths hidden to prevent the sidebar returning after login/provider updates. RightBoard already occupies the full page width. Retain the existing account message handlers and New/Open/Recent command dispatch; no native cloud-pane or account-service change is implied.
